authority_policy: Configured by the resolver binding, never fixed by a form or a pattern.
write_policy: Offline publisher creates a new database release; runtime consumers read only.
reader_policy: Public to every module/application; no caller allowlist.
transport_policy: Runtime access must use QNC URI -> resolver -> read-only endpoint in local/LAN/intranet. This release contains the portable dataset and offline publisher, not a network reader.
lifecycle: Immutable published artifact; no server, auto-updater, workflow or shared application state.

maintenance.policy: Explicit offline edits create a new release. Every change records a reason and before/after data; previous releases are not overwritten. Delete removes a pattern, not any card or media file.
maintenance.incorrect: Retained for inspection with reason, excluded from public_analysis_patterns until explicitly corrected and enabled.
maintenance.documented_patterns: Factory specifications plus synthetic contract fixtures are the normal verification basis. Owning a physical card for every camera is not required. Real cards provide additional evidence.
maintenance.partial_patterns: Incomplete factory specifications stay outside analysis candidates until the missing directory/naming/relationship evidence is supplied.

pattern_semantics.paths: Relative slash-separated expressions. * and ? operate within one segment; ** denotes zero or more directories. No absolute paths, parent segments, URLs, commands or scripts. A period alone means the selected root.
pattern_semantics.case_policy: Preserve spelling. Filesystem case semantics belong to the transport endpoint; do not lowercase stored paths.
pattern_semantics.root_variants: Alternatives, not mandatory simultaneous roots. Evaluate all roots on mixed cards. Missing roots for an unknown scope mean unknown, never match everything.
pattern_semantics.role_policy: File rules produce candidates, not a final clip list. Resolve documented relationships and mode before assigning original/proxy roles. Extensions do not prove codecs or camera models.
pattern_semantics.grouping: Prefer explicit camera manifest references, then verified metadata identities. Same-name hints alone are insufficient for ambiguous media, multiple roots, chunks or spanned clips.
pattern_semantics.unknown_policy: Keep unknown, ambiguous and incomplete groups visible as unresolved. Never silently discard, guess a camera, promote a proxy to original or run a probe fallback.
pattern_semantics.proof: Documentation and observed samples are evidence, not runtime support. Observed status is limited to the cited sample, model, mode and media; it does not certify all firmware or media variants.
pattern_semantics.metadata: XML namespace plus element/attribute selectors describe camera-written metadata. IDs for camera, volume, physical card and camera media index are distinct. XML readers must disable external entities and reject references escaping the source root.
pattern_semantics.probe_boundary: No ffprobe/media decoding in the catalog or recognition. Full media probe remains the single Select/Ingest pass. File extension and camera XML never replace measured media fields without provenance.

version_policy: Data revisions add evidence and profiles without changing app/UI code. New semantics or schema require a new contract version and compatible module, never embedded executable rules.
release_gate: A future detector must validate catalog identity/schema/version, reject unsupported semantics, resolve conflicts and pass fixtures derived from the cited factory specifications before declaring runtime support. Real-card tests are additional, not a requirement for every model.
